note: Starter hazard library for English Civil War reenactment sites. Replace or extend with the Sealed Knot workbook (SK_RA_Oct_23.xlsx) checklists.

hazards.controls: Walk the field before the event; mark or fill holes; brief units on known hazards.
Keep battle lines off steep ground; tape off banks; position public on level ground.
Re-walk after rain; adjust battle area; trackway or matting at entrances.
Fence or tape off; keep battle and camp clear; brief stewards.

hazards.hazard: Overhead power lines (pikes, flag poles, tent poles)
hazards.controls: Identify on site plan; exclusion zone with no pikes or poles raised beneath.
Check for dead branches; keep cavalry clear of low branches; no camping under unsafe trees.
Agree with landowner to remove stock; mark electric fences; clear dung from battle area.
Licensed storage; approved containers; magazine away from fires and tents; powder officer responsible.

hazards.hazard: Musket firing: burns, ear and eye injury
hazards.controls: Authorised and tested musketeers only; firing angles and minimum distances; no ramrods on field; ear protection advised.
Qualified gun captain; safety zones in front and behind guns; misfire drill; gun inspected.

hazards.hazard: Firing towards or near the public
hazards.controls: No firing towards crowd line; minimum distance from barrier; marshals monitor.
Authorised pikemen only; pikes checked for damage; officers control push; break-off signal known.
Blunt weapons checked; authorised combatants only; no head blows; stop signal.
Authorised riders; horses checked; cavalry lanes; keep public away from horse lines.
Real-casualty signal known to all; first aid on field edge; clear access route.
Fire pits raised or turf lifted; water/extinguisher by every fire; never left unattended; spacing from tents.
Barrier between public and cooking; food hygiene practices; hand washing.
Cylinders upright, outside tents, away from fires; check hoses; no gas in living history area.
Mark guy ropes; peg caps; keep walkways clear; lighting at night.
Minimum spacing between tents; fire lanes; fire points with extinguishers.

hazards.hazard: Edged weapons and tools on display
hazards.controls: Displays supervised; sharp items out of reach; demonstrations behind barrier.

hazards.hazard: Alcohol around fires, weapons and powder
hazards.controls: No drinking before or during battle; no powder handling after drinking; camp rules briefed.
Continuous barrier at safe distance; stewards; children kept behind line.
Vehicle curfew during public hours; walking pace; banksman for reversing; separate pedestrian routes.
Lost child point; stewards briefed; announcement procedure.
Keep emergency route clear; route marked on site plan; first aid point signed.

hazards.hazard: Heat exhaustion and sunburn (wool clothing, armour)
hazards.controls: Water on field; shorter battle in heat; shade; watch for symptoms.
Check forecast; dry clothing; warm shelter available.
Stop activity in lightning; lower pikes and flags; secure tents and gazebos.
Team lifts; use trolleys; brief on safe lifting.
Enough toilets and water points; hand washing near food.
